stem_book: A ball is released from rest from point P of a smooth semi-spherical vessel as shown in figure (P on the rim, O the centre). The ratio of the centripetal force and normal reaction on the ball at point Q is A, while the angular position of point Q is α with respect to point P (angle POQ). Which of the following graphs represents the correct relation between A and α when the ball goes from Q to R? (a) A falls steeply then flattens (concave up) (b) A rises from the origin and flattens (c) A is a horizontal straight line (constant) (d) A falls from a maximum to zero like a quarter circle
key: c A = 2/3, a constant — the horizontal-line graph, option (c)
reason: options are graphs; described in stem_book, figure bbox includes vessel and the four graphs
work: v² = 2gR sinα; F_c = 2mg sinα, N = mg sinα + mv²/R = 3mg sinα ⇒ A = 2/3 constant
